title: Strict ordinary quotient scalar tower comparison
statement: Fix a prime ell, finite coefficient extensions E and L with embedding iota, a scheme W, and an ordinary quotient model M [def-trf-completion-unit-models]. Let T apply the actual ordinary sequence scalar extension, restrict coefficients to the completed target ring, and read a complex of towers as a tower of complexes [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. There is a natural isomorphism theta: M.quotient followed by T to the defining direct integral scalar tower [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], on all cochain complexes P. For every strict presentation isomorphism a:M.quotient(P) to C and every finite comparison kappa with eval(a);kappa=M.evaluation, q=T(a inverse);theta(P) sends the scalar tensor section s tensor kappa inverse(1 tensor x), with the specified section casts, to the direct tensor section s tensor x at every quotient level n, degree i and pro-etale object U [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. This assertion is about ordinary strict complexes and has no derived-category realization or Roos-normalization hypothesis.

source.place: Tensor/restriction adjunction (03D7), tensor products (03EK); sites-cohomology.tex section-derived-limits (0941), the vertical sequence site. Balanced strict quotient refinement of the primitive scalar construction.

proof.text: Construct coefficient scalar systems around the prescribed actual sequence scalar model. The generic sequence ring map equals the actual ring map on every component. The normalized ordinary adjunction unit identifies its actual tensor section with scalar times the unit, retaining HEq through the model transport.

Choose the normalized ordinary scalar evaluation isomorphisms and the finite balanced associations. Compose these with M.evaluation degreewise, apply the existing all-complex successor compatibility theorem, and assemble a natural strict tower isomorphism, retaining its explicit finite component equation.

Invert eval(a);kappa=M.evaluation and apply it to 1 tensor x. The section evaluation identities show that a inverse sends the displayed kappa inverse section to the normalized quotient-unit section. Naturality of the ordinary scalar adjunction unit transports this identity through sequence scalar extension. The inverse balanced-association tensor formula then shows that the finite comparison sends s times this evaluated unit to s tensor x. The restriction and evaluation casts preserve these identities by HEq.

proof_origin.place: 03D7 and 03EK, ordinary normalized tensor adjunction and balanced association; fully proved strict tower assembly and presentation-unit calculation. Prescribe the sequence model instead of comparing arbitrary choices. No derived descent is used.

theorem ordinaryQuotientScalarTowerComparison
    (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E W) :
    let F := (integralComparisonSequenceScalarModel l E L ι W).E
    let T := F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
      (coefficientSequenceRestriction l L W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
      HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex
    ∃ θ : M.quotient l E W ⋙ T ≅ integralScalarTowerFunctor l E L ι W,
      ∀ (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ)
        (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E W) ℤ)
        (a : (M.quotient l E W).obj P ≅ C)
        (κ : ∀ n : ℕ,
          ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
            (unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E W n).obj P),
        (∀ n : ℕ,
          ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).mapIso a ≪≫
            κ n = (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (M.evaluation n) (.up ℤ)).app P) →
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
          (s : (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l L W).obj.obj (op (n, U.unop)))
          (x : (P.X i).val.obj U),
          (((T.mapIso a.symm ≪≫ θ.app P).hom.app (op n)).f i).val.app U
            (integralComparisonRestrictedSection l L W (F.obj (C.X i)) n U
              (integralComparisonSequenceTensorSection l E L ι W (C.X i)
                (op (n, U.unop)) s
                (integralComparisonSequenceSection l E W (C.X i) n U
                  (((κ n).inv.f i).val.app U
                    (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E W n (P.X i) U 1 x))))) =
            integralScalarTensorSection l E L ι W n (P.X i) U s x
